Group Lock Boxes and Bags guide

What Is a Group Lock Box?

Critical pointThe keys in the box must not be accessible until the last person on the team has removed their personal padlock, and energy should only be restored after that stage.

A group lock box is LOTO equipment used for maintenance jobs where the number of points to be locked out and the number of people on the team increase together. The responsible person first locks out all energy isolation points and places the keys to those padlocks inside the box. Then each worker on the team fits their own personal safety padlock to the box.

With this method, each worker does not need to apply a separate lock to dozens of points. The keys remain inaccessible until the last personal lock in the box is removed, so energy cannot be restored before the job is finished. It is one of the most efficient lockout methods in planned shutdowns and major overhauls.

LOTO bags let the technician carry padlocks, devices and tags to the field in an organized way. At Sofilx LOTO we supply multi-hole group boxes, key management boxes, portable plastic boxes, and waist-type, personal, mini, waterproof and lockable bags. When choosing, team size and field conditions should be considered together.

Buying guide

How to Choose the Right Group Lock Box?

Check these criteria before ordering. If you are unsure, send a photo and we will choose together.

Ask an expert
  • Team size: Determine the maximum number of people who will fit padlocks to the box at the same time and choose the number of holes accordingly.
  • Key capacity: The box should have enough internal volume to comfortably hold the keys for all locked-out isolation points.
  • Portability: For teams working at different locations, choose a portable box or bag.
  • Work environment: In damp and outdoor areas, use protected models such as a waterproof bag.
  • Key tracking: If facility-wide key control is required, add key management boxes to the system.
  • Written procedure: Clearly define the group lockout sequence and the responsible person in your written LOTO procedure.
Applications

Where Are Group Lock Boxes and Bags Used?

Planned shutdown maintenance

Used during overhaul periods in factories when many machines are taken into maintenance at the same time.

Power plants and transformers

Gathers keys in one place for electrical maintenance with many isolation points.

Petrochemicals and refineries

Organizes team lockout when isolating large pipelines and valve groups.

Field service teams

Lets technicians carry lockout equipment safely in a bag or box.

Frequently asked questions

About Group Lock Boxes and Bags

If you could not find the answer you are looking for, message us on WhatsApp and we will determine the right model together.

Ask on WhatsApp
How is a group lock box used?
The responsible person locks all energy points and places the keys in the box. Each worker then attaches their own personal lock to the box; the keys cannot be reached until the last lock is removed.
What does 12+1 mean?
12 holes are reserved for team members' personal padlocks, and the additional 1 hole is for the supervisor's padlock.
What is the difference between a lockout hasp and a group box?
A lockout hasp allows several locks to be attached at a single isolation point. A group box gathers the keys of many points in one place and is more practical for crowded, multi-point jobs.
How much do group lock boxes and LOTO bags cost?
The price varies by model, material, size and order quantity. For a current quote, you can send the product code and quantity to our WhatsApp line or call us by phone.
Do LOTO bags come fully stocked?
Bags are offered separately and empty. If you want a ready-made solution, take a look at our belt-bag or portable LOTO kits.
What is a key management box for?
Provides controlled storage of lock keys, tracking of which key is held by whom, and security of spare keys.
Which bag should be used outdoors?
In humid and open areas, the BD-8770A waterproof portable lockout bag should be preferred.

Group Lock Box and LOTO Bag Prices and Models

In maintenance where several people work on the same machine or piping, the most reliable way to make sure everyone is protected is group lockout. The group lock box brings the isolation keys together at a single point and prevents energy from being restored until the last worker removes their lock.

The Sofilx LOTO category includes 12+1 and 18+1 hole group lock boxes, key management boxes, portable plastic LOTO boxes and waist-type, personal, lockable or waterproof LOTO bag models. This way both central group lockout and on-site equipment carrying needs are met from a single category.

The price of a group lock box and LOTO bag is determined by model, material, size and quantity. To choose the right model and get a current quote, you can reach us on our WhatsApp line or by phone.
